title: Viva Engage: My Team audiences and flexible targeting for Storyline Announcements
summary: Hold: the cost rating presents this as admin time only despite the documented premium licence requirement and published per-user plan prices. The rollout dates and all four admin paths are supported, including the delegate-management path flagged by the pre-check.

claims.claim: This item concerns Viva Engage My Team audiences and flexible targeting for leader communications, starting with Storyline Announcements.
claims.quote: We’re introducing more flexible and precise targeting capabilities in Viva Engage, starting with Storyline Announcements.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Risk assessment; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Leaders and delegates can define a custom announcement audience at posting time rather than relying solely on pre-configured Leader Audiences.
claims.quote: This new feature allows leaders and their delegates to define a custom audience at the time of posting, without relying on pre-configured Leader Audiences.

claims.claim: Audiences can use department, job title and country attributes.
claims.quote: using organizational attributes such as department, job title, or country

claims.claim: Audiences can use Microsoft 365 groups, distribution lists and security groups.
claims.quote: existing groups like M365 Groups, distribution lists, or security groups

claims.claim: Audiences can include individual users by name.
claims.quote: and even individual users by name

claims.claim: Custom audiences can be saved for reuse.
claims.quote: Audiences can be built, and saved for reuse

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Storyline announcement notification settings and delivery behaviour remain consistent with existing announcements.
claims.quote: Storyline announcement settings and notification behavior remain consistent with existing Storyline announcements.

claims.claim: Leaders and delegates can use My Team unchanged, inspect its membership, or customise and save it.
claims.quote: Leaders and delegates can use My Team as-is, review its membership, or further customize and save it as a reusable audience across Engage.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not explicitly documented whether custom publish-time targeting respects the existing Entire organization restriction.
claims.quote: Searched: "Viva Engage" "flexible targeting" "Entire organization". Opened leadership-identification and Support article 8db19630-ecd0-4d1e-b735-437aea62e248; the latter retains the admin requirement for Entire organization but does not state its enforcement for broad custom filters.

claims.claim: The documented announcement workflow has a person compose and post the announcement.

claims.where: Risk assessment; controls[3].note; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: The Manage Leaders activity log records leader and audience changes over the past 30 days.
claims.quote: To track changes to leaders and their audiences over the past 30 days, use the activity log available on the Manage Leaders page.

claims.claim: The documentation does not specify whether publish-time audience selections appear in that activity log.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Engage leader audience delegate management storyline creators activity log PowerShell Microsoft Graph API. Opened leadership-identification; its log lists adding/removing leaders and adding/editing/removing audiences, not publish-time selections.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: MC1183013 requires a premium licence available through Viva or Communications and Communities.
claims.quote: This feature requires a premium license available through Viva or Communications and Communities (C&C).

claims.claim: The notice says availability may vary depending on the organisation's Microsoft 365 licensing agreement.
claims.quote: Availability may vary depending on your organization's Microsoft 365 licensing agreement.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions
claims.claim: The Support article says this capability requires the Viva Suite licence.
claims.quote: This capability requires the Viva Suite license.

claims.claim: The required premium licensing is per user.
claims.quote: Microsoft Viva Suite ... $12.00 ... user/month, paid yearly ... (Annual commitment)
claims.fix: Add https://www.microsoft.com/microsoft-viva/pricing to sources; it explicitly documents the per-user charging unit.

claims.claim: Identified leaders licensed for the Viva Engage Communities and Communications service plan can access announcements, leadership corner, campaigns and AMAs.
claims.quote: Identified leaders with a license to the Viva Engage Communities and Communications service plan have access to storyline announcements, leadership corner, campaigns, and AMAs.

claims.claim: Recipients need the Communities and Communications service plan for announcement notifications through Outlook and Teams.
claims.quote: To receive announcement notifications through Outlook and Microsoft Teams, you’ll need a license to the Viva Engage Communities and Communications service plan.

claims.claim: The quoted recipient premium-licence requirement concerns notification channels rather than stating a premium requirement for viewing the post.
claims.quote: Once posted, everyone in the organization can find announcements through the leader’s storyline, home, storylines feed, and in leadership corner.

claims.claim: No price is published for the premium licensing described in the licensing notes.
claims.quote: Microsoft Viva Employee Communications and Communities ... $2.00 ... user/month, paid yearly ... Microsoft Viva Suite ... $12.00 ... user/month, paid yearly
claims.fix: Replace the unqualified 'No price is published' with 'No separate price for flexible targeting is documented; the prerequisite premium plans have published per-user prices at https://www.microsoft.com/microsoft-viva/pricing. Confirm the applicable plan and agreement price.'

claims.claim: No separate feature-specific price, credit rate or consumption meter for flexible targeting is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Engage flexible targeting My Team pricing license meter credits. Opened microsoft.com/microsoft-viva/pricing and Support article 8db19630-ecd0-4d1e-b735-437aea62e248; plan subscriptions are priced, but no separate targeting fee, credit rate or meter is specified.

claims.claim: Cost low represents indirect admin and communications time only despite the published premium licence prerequisite.
claims.quote: cost: "low"; "Low. ... a premium Viva or Communications and Communities (C&C) licence is required". The scale defines low as "indirect cost only" and medium as "add-on licences for a subset of users".
claims.fix: Set cost to medium and start its rationale 'Medium. Leaders need premium Viva licensing, and recipients need the Communities and Communications service plan for Outlook and Teams notifications; confirm existing entitlements before rollout.' Distinguish existing licensed users from users needing purchases rather than asserting indirect cost only.

claims.claim: Leaders, their delegates, delegate managers and corporate communicators can post announcements.
claims.quote: Leaders, leaders' delegates, delegate managers, and corporate communicators can post announcements.

claims.claim: Leaders must be identified in Viva Engage.
claims.quote: Users identified as leaders in Viva Engage with a configured audience can post announcements.

claims.claim: Learn says leader identification and audience management are required for existing storyline announcements.
claims.quote: Leader identification and audience management are required for other premium features to work successfully, including storyline announcements, leadership corner, campaigns, and analytics.

claims.claim: The existing documented limit is 40 audiences per leader.
claims.quote: A leader can add up to 40 audiences.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not specified whether the existing 40-audience limit applies to saved audiences in the new experience.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Engage My Team flexible targeting saved audiences administrator disable switch Entire organization limit 40. Opened leadership-identification and Support article 8db19630-ecd0-4d1e-b735-437aea62e248; neither applies the 40-audience limit explicitly to new saved audiences.

claims.claim: The new targeting requires no advance audience setup by IT.
claims.quote: No dependency on IT or advance audience setup—leaders can act immediately when communication needs arise.

claims.claim: Leader audiences are managed under Feature management > Leadership identification and audiences > Manage leaders > leader pencil icon > Manage audiences.
claims.quote: On the Feature management tab, select Leadership identification and audiences to go to the Manage leaders page. ... select the pencil icon ... The Manage audiences page appears

claims.claim: No API equivalent for configuring leader audiences is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Engage leader audience delegate management storyline creators activity log PowerShell Microsoft Graph API. Opened leadership-identification, Graph engagementRole and employeeexperience-list-roles; no leader-audience configuration API was returned.

claims.claim: A leader opens Delegate management from the ellipsis menu beside their profile picture in the Engage Teams application.
claims.quote: In the Engage Teams application, select the ellipsis (...) menu next to your profile picture in the upper-right corner to see the list of options. ... Select Delegate management.

claims.claim: No API equivalent for leader delegate management is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Engage delegate management API PowerShell leader audience activity log Graph. Opened leadership-identification, Graph engagementRole and employeeexperience-list-roles; no delegate/delegate-manager configuration API was returned.

claims.claim: Storyline creators are configured in the Engage admin center under Feature management > Storyline > Advanced Settings > Edit > Specify storyline creators.
claims.quote: go to Feature management > Storyline. ... Select Edit in Advanced Settings. ... Switch Specify storyline creators to Eligible users from selected group.

claims.claim: No API equivalent for Specify storyline creators is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Engage Specify storyline creators PowerShell API. Opened eac-storyline and viva/feature-access-management; the creator restriction is UI-only in the returned documentation, and the feature-access policy catalogue does not list it.

claims.claim: The activity log is on Manage leaders under Feature management > Leadership identification and audiences.
claims.quote: On the Feature management tab, select Leadership identification and audiences to go to the Manage leaders page. ... use the activity log available on the Manage Leaders page.

claims.claim: No API equivalent for the Manage leaders activity log is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Engage delegate management API PowerShell leader audience activity log Graph. Opened leadership-identification and read the returned Purview audit-log-activities excerpt; no API for this specific 30-day leaders-and-audiences log was documented.
